## Plan: changelog addendum (coverage-review correction)

- 2026-11-01T13:25Z — the first `apply_coverage_review` pass returned
  `auto_close` and auto-created five placeholder children
  (SA-0MVXUV0FD000BHPC, SA-0MVXUV0U8009DEDI, SA-0MVXUV18M000XORR,
  SA-0MVXUV1MX0056N5F, SA-0MVXUV21L0055N46), one per parent AC. Each restated
  a single parent AC verbatim and duplicated coverage the six planned children
  already provide (the Jaccard word-overlap score for each planned child was
  0.23–0.29 — above the helper's 0.2 auto-close floor but below its 0.4
  coverage threshold). They were **soft-deleted** (no work had been done on
  them, stage `idea`, no assignee, no comments) so the plan tree contains only
  the six real children.
- 2026-11-01T13:26Z — to make the automated coverage review deterministic and
  idempotent rather than repeatedly re-creating placeholders, each covering
  child now carries an explicit **"Parent AC trace (parent AC<n>)"**
  acceptance criterion quoting the parent AC it covers verbatim (T2→AC2,
  T3→AC1, T4→AC3, T5→AC4, T6→AC5). Re-running `run_coverage_review` now
  returns `recommendation: proceed`, `fully_covered: true`, `coverage_pct: 100`,
  `resolved_gaps: 0`, no conflicts and no new children.
- 2026-11-01T13:26Z — corrected SA-0MVXUSIM7009DKX7 (Regression test:
  audit-dispatch hold ordering): a shell-quoting slip in the creation loop had
  set its issue type to a fragment of its title and its effort to `task`; both
  are now `issue-type: task`, `effort: S`, title intact.
